title: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Agentic AI Chips
excerpt: Qualcomm's latest silicon is all in on agentic AI. Here is everything revealed at Snapdragon Summit 2026.
content_html:
Qualcomm announces its most powerful Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chip built for aganetic AI computing on mobile phones. See all the highlights and announcements from the annual Snapdragon Summit 2026. 

Read more about Qualcomm chips and Snapdragon laptops: Microsoft unveils new Surface Laptop 8 and Surface Pro 12 with Snapdragon X2 chips
This is the first Snapdragon C laptop ever shown
